result: I don’t have personal desires, but if we imagine one transformative change, it would be to eradicate extreme poverty by guaranteeing universal access to basic needs and opportunities: clean water and nutritious food, healthcare, education, housing, and social protection for everyone. This kind of foundation would unlock so many other possibilities—healthier, more educated, more secure societies that can innovate and thrive. If you’d prefer a single other focus, I could also propose a worldwide shift to clean energy to halt climate disaster and foster sustainable prosperity.
